name: Kit Navarro
want: keep the station running and get everyone home in one piece
voice: Dry and direct, short sentences; swears at machinery, never at people.
description: Keeps Ares Deep's machines alive and has an opinion about every one of them. The crew trusts Kit because Kit says out loud what's broken.
appearance: Wiry and pale from months indoors, with a shaved head, grease-dark knuckles and a multitool clipped to every pocket.
